notes: 3U Z-panel frame for up to 9 plates angled up or down. Each position here is one NZPFD single-D plate; with NZPFD-2 dual plates the frame takes 18 connectors (add the second connector of a plate as another device). Chassis connectors (cards here) and plates are bought separately.

name: NO2-4FDW-A opticalCON DUO ADVANCED chassis connector
notes: 2-channel rugged fibre feed-through: opticalCON DUO on the front, standard LC duplex on the rear. D-size mounting, metal shutter, IP65 when mated with an SCDP gasket. Gasket colours: black multimode, blue single-mode PC, green single-mode APC.

name: NO4FDW-A opticalCON QUAD ADVANCED chassis connector
notes: 4-channel rugged fibre feed-through: opticalCON QUAD on the front, four LC connectors on the rear. D-size mounting, metal shutter, IP65 when mated with an SCDP gasket. Gasket colours: black multimode, blue single-mode PC, green single-mode APC.
